description: Erection of a single storey extension to the existing garage
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 38000, 38001, 38002, 38003, 38007, 38008, 38009 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding referred to in this decision may only be used for purposes incidental to the use of the house known as 38 Park Drive, W3 8NA as a single family dwelling and shall not contain primary residential accommodation such as a bathroom, bedroom, kitchen or living room, nor may it be used for business purposes.
